text:
Anya: Quick sync — annual planning offsite is penciled for May 11-12. I dropped a very rough draft agenda and a facilitation playbook here: https://drive.redwood/notes/offsite-2026-draft. Need to lock facilitators + prework owners by EOD Friday.
Miguel: I can take Product Strategy facilitation if Samir can co-run the prioritization exercise.
Samir: Yep I can co-run prioritization. Suggest we use the RICE-lite matrix and a 3-round dot vote.
Jen: Happy to own Customer Signals breakout (aka 'what customer problems do we double-down on').
Olivia: I can do logistics for in-person stuff (room layout, A/V). Do we have headcount limits? Need to confirm hybrid dial-in setup.
Anya: Headcount cap is 48 for main room, plus 12 overflow. If turnout >60 we'll split into 2 concurrent rooms and rotate tracks.
Miguel: For facilitation style — I propose 45m blocks: 30m structured activity + 15m synthesis. Keeps energy up.
Anya: Agreed. Also need prework owners to circulate one-pagers (1 page max) that summarize: current state, metrics, asks, and decision needed. Who can draft templates?
Ravi: I can sketch the one-pager template tonight. Suggest fields: Context, Key metric(s), Customer quote, Options, Decision ask.
Samir: Add a section for risk/rollback constraints so engineering has clarity.
Anya: Good call. I'll add that. Also we should standardize artifacts in this checklist:

```
Session template:
- Goal: clear decision or prioritized list
- Timebox: 45m
- Facilitator: <name>
- Prework: 1-pager (link)
- Data owner: <name>
- Outputs: actions + owners
- Follow-up eval: 2-week pulse
```

Miguel: Could we run a 20-min cross-team sync at the start on adopters & metrics? Helps align scoring.
Jen: yes please — that will surface customer asks before we vote.
Anya: Facilitation volunteers so far: Product Strategy = Miguel (+Samir), Prioritization = Samir (+Miguel), Customer Signals = Jen. Need two more: rollout/launch criteria and platform/resourcing.
Olivia: I can pull together room layout options and AV checklist by Wednesday.
Ravi: ops-bot, can you provision two breakout whiteboards and 2x extra mics for hybrid?
ops-bot: Requested: 2x whiteboards, 2x wireless mics. ETA: Wed 10:00. Room confirmed: Main Hall A.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Redwood Annual Planning Offsite — May 11-12" attendees prepopulated. Tentative room hold until confirm. Link: https://calendar.redwood/evt/alen/1795
Samir: One more thought — let's protect a 90-min synthesis block at the end of day 2 to turn outputs into next-quarter OKRs. If teams leave earlier we lose momentum.
Anya: Yes — blocking that now. Also want a short async pre-read to go out 7 days before: one-pagers + current metric dashboard. Who can own the dashboard snapshot?
Miguel: I can export the metrics snapshot and drop in the pre-read doc on Friday.
Jen: I'll compile customer notes and send a short primer.
Anya: Perfect. Final asks: 1) facilitators and prework owners confirmed by Friday EOD, 2) logistics confirmation (AV/rooms) by Wed, 3) calendar RSVPs by next Tues. Thanks all — will follow up with a checklist thread.
